subject: PO wave schedule and triggers for Q1 bookings recognition
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: PO wave schedule and triggers for Q1 bookings recognition

Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. To keep bookings recognition moving cleanly on our end we want to align on PO arrival windows and the minimal invoice triggers. Attached is a draft "PO_schedule_Q1.xlsx" that breaks the Q1 bookings into three waves and the corresponding invoicing/acceptance checkpoints. High level asks: 

- Can procurement confirm expected PO issue windows for each wave (dates or target weeks)?
- For POs that will be issued as blanket PO + SOW, can you confirm the referencing convention so our finance team matches invoices automatically?
- Are there any internal approval hold points (e.g., legal review weeks) we should model into the acceptance timeline?

If useful, we can propose a 30-minute pre-bill call next Wed (1/18) to lock the final cutoffs.

Thanks — I want to avoid recognition slippage for your Jan bookings.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: PO_schedule_Q1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luke Patterson <l.patterson@horizonhealth.com>, Horizon Health Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 12:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO wave schedule and triggers for Q1 bookings recognition

Ben —

Thanks for the breakdown and the attachment. A few quick items from procurement: 

- Our plan today is to issue Wave 1 POs by week of Jan 22, Wave 2 by week of Feb 5, Wave 3 by week of Feb 26. Those are tentative pending exec approvals.
- We typically use the format "HH-PO-<Deal#>" for blanket PO references; I will confirm if Legal wants any additional wording for SOW attachments.
- There is a procurement gating review that runs the first Friday of each month — that may delay any POs that hit the board after the 1/4 cutoff.

Two asks for Redwood: 
1) Can you provide a minimal invoice checklist (fields/PO ref + required acceptance email) so AP can auto-match?
2) Please include an explicit fallback if a PO slips beyond the target week (i.e., can Redwood accept an interim invoice against a pending PO number and then reissue once PO arrives?)

I copied Luke (ops) and Procurement so they can weigh in.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Director, Strategic Sourcing | Horizon Health
elena@horizonhealth.com | 617-555-0114

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO wave schedule and triggers for Q1 bookings recognition

Elena —

Appreciate the timing context — that helps. Quick answers inline below and I've attached a one-page invoice checklist and a proposed fallback policy.

On auto-match fields: our finance team needs PO ref, invoice number, invoice date, total amount, and a short acceptance email from your project owner referencing the invoice number. I've attached "Horizon_PO_template.pdf" as an example we can use if helpful.

On interim invoicing: we can accept interim invoices against a placeholder PO ID if Procurement confirms a unique temporary reference (e.g., HH-PO-TEMP-<Deal#>). When the final PO arrives we will do a simple one-line credit/rebill to align amounts — this keeps recognition timely but preserves audit trail.

I've updated the attached spreadsheet with the Wave dates you proposed and added the cutoff for our internal revenue gate (end-of-day on the final week Friday). Please review and let me know any conflicts.

If those items look good, let's lock the pre-bill call for Wed 1/18 10:00am PT — I will send a calendar invite.

Ben

Attachment: Horizon_PO_template.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO wave schedule and triggers for Q1 bookings recognition

Looping back after the pre-bill call this morning — quick summary for the ledger and finance ops: 

- Confirmed Wave dates: Jan 22, Feb 5, Feb 26 (Procurement to email final PO dates by EOD Monday 1/24).
- Agreed invoice checklist for auto-match (PO ref, invoice number, date, total, owner acceptance).
- Temporary PO flow accepted: Procurement will issue HH-PO-TEMP-<Deal#> when approvals are pending; final PO will reference the same deal number and we will do a one-line credit/rebill as needed. 
- Finance gate: Redwood needs final invoice + matching PO (or temp PO + acceptance email) in our system by close of business Friday of each wave week to meet the recognition cutoff. Missing this will push recognition to the next wave.

Action items: 
- Procurement (Horizon): send confirmed PO dates and confirm temp PO naming convention by 1/24. (Luke / Elena)
- Redwood (Ben): send final invoice checklist to Horizon AP and post the accepted Flow in our shared Drive. (ben.carter)
- Redwood Finance (Karthik): prepare a short GL journal note for delayed recognition paths in case a PO misses the cutoff. (karthik.iyer)

I'll follow-up with the calendar invite for any postmortem if a slip occurs.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | 415-555-0182
